# Comments at the end of the lines of a call's arguments are kept.
celfmt -i member.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_member.txt

celfmt -i want_member.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_member.txt

celfmt -i macro.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_macro.txt

celfmt -i want_macro.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_macro.txt

celfmt -i first.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_first.txt

celfmt -i want_first.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_first.txt

# A // in a string is not the start of a comment, and a comment that has
# a // in it is kept whole.
celfmt -i string.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_string.txt

celfmt -i slashes.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout slashes.cel

-- member.cel --
state.x.with(
	state.y // c1
)
-- want_member.txt --
state.x.with(
	state.y // c1
)
-- macro.cel --
state.x.as(y,
	y.z.as(w,
		w + 1 // c2
	)
)
-- want_macro.txt --
state.x.as(y,
	y.z.as(w,
		w + 1 // c2
	)
)
-- first.cel --
state.x.as(y, // c4
	y + 1
)
-- want_first.txt --
state.x.as(y, // c4
	y + 1
)
-- string.cel --
state.x.as(a, a + "http://example.com/" + a
	+ "x"
)
-- want_string.txt --
state.x.as(a,
	a + "http://example.com/" + a + "x"
)
-- slashes.cel --
state.x.with(
	state.y // see http://x // and more
)
